'''LVL6''' operated in [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. A [[Color|purple]] [[Aurebesh]] sign, using regular Aurebesh characters and a digit written in an [[Alternative Aurebesh numerals|alternate numeral system]], was located at the city [[Daiyu spaceport|spaceport]] at the front, with a blue sign going vertically down the side. Another green sign was located in the [[city]] streets.<ref name="Kenobi" />
